ideas.title: FBI's Refusal to Share Evidence in Alex Pretti Shooting Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI's denial of evidence access to Minnesota officials in the Alex Pretti shooting investigation
ideas.angle: Interagency cooperation and potential implications for justice
questions: What are the implications of the FBI's refusal to share evidence?
How will this affect the investigation and potential prosecution?
ideas.insight: The FBI's denial of evidence access to Minnesota officials raises concerns about cooperation between federal and state agencies. This story could explore the implications of this refusal and potential effects on the investigation.
